diagram_math_checks.justification: Statement; proof steps 1.1, 1.3-1.4. Independently checked the local existence theorem step 1.2: bases end in e4-e5,e5 for B5 (squared lengths 2,1) and e4-e5,2e5 for C5 (2,4). Thus both arrows point to the shorter root and the long/short squared-length ratio is 2.
